title: Writers decide under the writer lock, against the history they append onto
note: D-2026-147. The agent directory and the memory store checked their rules against the projection they had loaded and appended outside the writer lock, so an honest race wrote a history the reducer refuses forever. Each mutation puts one decision back outside the lock or deletes one write-path restatement of a replay rule; tests/test_agent_toctou.py races two projections of one log (and two processes on a barrier) and requires the loser refused and the log loadable.

mutations.name: T1_the_directory_decides_against_its_loaded_view
mutations.rationale: D-2026-147: the directory's checks run against the projection it loaded, so a second answer from a stale view is written and the history no longer loads

mutations.name: T2_the_directory_catch_up_folds_nothing_new
mutations.rationale: D-2026-147: the anchored catch-up reads what others appended and folds none of it, so the decision is again made against a stale view

mutations.name: T3_a_retired_principal_answers_at_write_time
mutations.rationale: D-2026-147: the write path lets a principal retired meanwhile answer; the replay refuses it, and the log stops loading

mutations.name: T4_a_second_registration_is_written
mutations.rationale: D-2026-147: two registrations of one instance are both written; the replay refuses the second

mutations.name: T5_a_second_escalation_with_one_id_is_written
mutations.rationale: D-2026-147: two escalations with one id are both written; the replay refuses the second

mutations.name: T6_a_second_claim_with_one_id_is_written
mutations.rationale: D-2026-147: two claims with one id are both written; the replay refuses the second

mutations.name: T7_memory_decides_against_its_loaded_view
mutations.rationale: D-2026-147: two writers of one memory id both write it, and every later load refuses the history

mutations.name: T8_memory_writes_an_edge_the_replay_refuses
mutations.find: if status is not cur.status and status not in allowed:
mutations.rationale: D-2026-147: a supersede racing a retraction is written; the replay refuses RETRACTED -> SUPERSEDED

mutations.name: T9_the_cascade_moves_an_entry_withdrawn_meanwhile
mutations.find: if only_if_current and cur.status in NOT_CURRENT:
mutations.rationale: D-2026-147: the invalidation cascade moves an entry retracted meanwhile; the replay refuses RETRACTED -> STALE
